mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced cost of capital.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS < 0.1% periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 1400) and retail sales (RSAFS < 500000) indicate weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1400 and RSAFS < 500000, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (GDP above 17000 billion 2017 dollars and unemployment below 4.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over 60 days due to overvaluation and policy tightening.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances meeting the regime condition, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profits and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate combined with high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals aggressive monetary tightening and labor market weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is rising and UNRATE > 5.0, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 250 (index) indicates elevated inflation, prompting central bank rate hikes that reduce equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in CPIAUCSL > 250 periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 7.0% signals economic distress, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 7.0, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
